name: Klap
summary: AI video clipper that turns long videos into vertical clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, with captions, reframing, scheduling and a free trial on one video.
best_for: creators, podcasters and small teams with long videos who want vertical clips with captions and reframing made automatically, and who will post often enough to use a plan of 100 to 1,000 clips a month
skip_if: you want to cut every clip by hand, you only need one or two shorts a year, you want a permanent free plan, or you want a tool we have tested through a paid plan ourselves
honest_knock: The cheap price is the yearly one: monthly billing is double, so a trial month is the costly way in. The only free try is one video, and nothing can be downloaded or posted without paying. Klap selects the clips, so the cut may not be the one you would make. We have not paid for a plan, so how it holds up over months is unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed yearly ($174 a year) for 100 clips a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on klap.app/pricing, US dollars) Three plans, each with AI clipping, captions, scheduling and analytics. Basic: 100 clips a month, $14.50 a month billed yearly ($174 a year) or $29 month to month. Pro: 300 clips, $39.50 a month billed yearly ($474 a year) or $79 monthly. Pro+: 1,000 clips, $94.50 a month billed yearly ($1,134 a year) or $189 monthly. Free trial on 1 video, no card; downloading and posting need a paid plan. API priced separately: $0.44 per input video, $0.32 per short, $0.48 per export. We have not paid for a plan.
